A diagonal crossing of a deeper core cannot pierce the earlier body contact
A vertical projectile can hit the upper core at the first body contact
A shot starting inside the body cannot borrow a deeper critical later in its segment
Front and rear zones remain reachable from their intended incoming sides
Combo escape knockback follows return flight instead of original shooter facing
Last impact records the first surface point and a clipped trajectory
Reset clears diagnostic contacts and draw never changes combat state
Controlled input replay preserves contact telemetry and complete combat state
